issues.problem: The Sunzi story added 'such a force is strong and must be waited out', which is an interpretation and not in the 軍争篇 line (無邀正正之旗、勿擊堂堂之陳).
issues.action: Cut that clause; the story now says only that a general should not intercept well-ordered banners or attack an army in imposing array, then gives the Japanese sense. Source kept.

issues.problem: ctx1 (練習とは違い、今日は真剣勝負だ) fits 一発勝負 just as well: 'unlike practice, today is a one-shot deal'.
issues.action: Rewrote it as a coach telling players to treat every practice session (毎回) as 真剣勝負; 'every time' rules out 一発勝負. English updated.

issues.problem: bad1 (いつも準備万端な人) is not clearly wrong: natives do say いつも準備万端だ of a person, so the misuse was only debatable.
issues.action: Replaced it with 隅々まで準備万端に磨いた (meant: polished thoroughly), a clear misuse as an adverb of thoroughness.

issues.problem: The near diff called 用意周到 only a character trait; it also describes plans.
issues.action: Reworded the diff to 'careful foresight that provides for every possibility (用意周到な人 / 計画)'.
